summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact feet-to-metres rounding) and 0013 (full_name without concat_ws, unavailable in SQLite 3.40), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 collectors, deferred taxa, all five basis codes).
